title: Container Bookings: change of destination availability and fee by tier
content:
## Scope
This card covers the Container Bookings product line and states, per tier, whether a change of port of discharge may be requested after confirmation and the change-of-destination fee per container.

## What each setting means
- **Change of destination allowed**: whether a change of port of discharge may be requested after confirmation.
- **Change-of-destination fee**: USD per container.

## Tier card
| Tier | Change of destination allowed | Change-of-destination fee (USD per container) |
|---|---|---|
| AHL Spot Saver | no | 0.00 |
| AHL Spot Flex | yes | 350.00 |
| AHL Contract Booking | yes | 300.00 |
| AHL Contract Priority | yes | 250.00 |
| AHL Guaranteed Loading | no | 0.00 |
| AHL Premium Express | yes | 300.00 |

## Points of judgement
**On which tiers can the port of discharge not be changed after confirmation?** AHL Spot Saver and AHL Guaranteed Loading; their fee is shown as 0.00.

**Which allowed tier has the highest per-container fee?** AHL Spot Flex, at 350.00.
